exceptions.title: Segments cover only the five named boroughs; city-wide totals include all records.
exceptions.cause: The legacy daily_total query has no borough filter, while the daily_segments query keeps only BRONX, BROOKLYN, MANHATTAN, QUEENS and STATEN ISLAND. Requests whose borough was any other value were never fetched at segment level, so the segment sum is lower than the city-wide total on most dates. The excluded records cannot be recovered from this snapshot and no records are imputed.
